title: High Tide Cocktail (Home Recreation)
headnote: Unverified home recreation of the High Tide served at Driftwood, Laguna Beach. User enjoyed the restaurant cocktail; no evidence of tasting this home recreation yet. Makes one cocktail.

ingredientGroups.title: Cocktail
items: Optional: a few drops saline solution

steps: For the ginger syrup, combine sugar, water, and sliced ginger. Simmer for 10 minutes, let steep 20 minutes, then strain and chill.
Lightly slap the mint leaves to release their aroma. Add rye, pineapple juice, fresh lemon juice, ginger syrup, and mint to a shaker with ice.
Dump into a rocks or tiki glass over crushed ice and garnish with mint and pineapple; add optional candied ginger.
Taste and adjust for balance. This recreation uses fresh lemon rather than the commercial lemon sour mix listed in the restaurant description.
